sched: Individual members have no authority to act on their own but meet as a board in a formal session.
The Board of Trustees meet on the second Monday of every month at 7:00 p.
Those meetings are open to the public at the Caldwell School District Darrel Deide Administration Building located at 107 Poplar Street, Caldwell ID 83605.
Patron Input / Addressing the Board: Meetings of the Board of Trustees follow a standard, published agenda.
The Chairman of the Board presides at all meetings.
Patrons who wish to comment on agenda items under discussion may do so by signing in with the Clerk of the Board prior to the beginning of the respective meeting.
